item.title: Money for Girls: Amortized
item.description:
Title: Money for Girls: Amortized
Genre: Indie , RPG
Developer: Porpentine
Publisher: INNOCENT Interactive
Release Date: Aug 24, 2026




About This Game

"You look like a million bucks in a ten-ounce swear jar."

A girl detective faces her greatest mystery yet: saving her mom from crippling debt. But bewa re: the gorgeous tropical landscape conceals a world of sin. The popular girl at school has shown a disturbing interest in you, and your mother's predatory loan is dressed to kill. Can your sugary heart survive, or will the ants feast?

✦

horror/romance | "slice of life" 🗡️
visual novel | bad ends | outfits | stickers ✨

✦ Customize your girl with 16 stickers. OCD, Horse Girl, Endometriosis, and even the mysterious Boyborn are just some of the sticky friends or marks of shame you will acquire along the way...

✦ Discover 7 spellbinding outfits! Your fashion, your rules!

✦ Unleash your financial prowess by humiliating yourself for petty cash! Kaching!

✦ Maintain mood and hygiene or face drastic consequences.

✦ Many scenes are optional or nonlinear. How will you spend your summer?

✦ LOTS of choices! Will you pursue cold avarice, or the warmth of love? Or something really stupid

✦ MANY horrible endings may befall the girl who snoops, sticking her nose where it doesn't belong. Collect them in your gallery and stare upon them to internalize the moral lesson!

✦ Absolutely NO monster girls. NONE. DON'T LOOK FOR EM

✦ Take photos of stylish babes for CLUE REASONS.

✦ Buy secret art at the Pink Market, featuring some of the greatest guest artists ever locked in a basement.

✦ Explore the peninsular beauty of Sororal Quasisland, with breathtaking locations that will leap off your screen!

✦ Experience wakeboarding, skydiving, and hot air ballooning! But not in this game.

✦ Adventure, malice, and even romance...

DAMES

📸 Cancer 📸

YOU, dummy!! The plucky 20-something girl detective! Forensic photographer? Attending school with real humans for the first time.

⭐ Agnel ⭐

Your bully classmate. Extremely normal. No secrets.

🐜 Sugar Mommy 🐜

What if a predatory loan was a woman?

🧪 Your Mom 🧵

Brilliant ex-fashion scientist. Severely in debt.

🍯 Sugar Puppet 🍯

Employee of the year century forever. One of those side characters who doesn't appear much...but she tries her best!

Less than five hundred thousand words.

Fewer than 8,000 unique routes .

Over less than two trillion art.

Length
A few hours of fun, or more if you're a freak. It's full of pictures and creepy stories and cute girls. Whaddya want from me

CREDIT CARD

🖊️ Writing/code/directing/additional audio by Xrafstar 🦟
🖌️ Art by Vich 🐀
🎶 Soundtrack by Lauren Bousfield, featuring songs by Ada Rook, ESPer99, and Ash Nerve
🖼️ Guest art by Chey, Dash, and Demi

✦

I have included some wretched choices in the game. I am trusting the player to pick none of them.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains mature content, such as blood, gore, nudity, suggestive situations, harassment, bondage imagery, self-harm, homophobia, alcoholism, grossness, and adult language. Many scenes are brief, textual, or optional.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: Din's Champion
item.description:
Title: Din's Champion
Genre: Action , Indie , RPG
Developer: Soldak Entertainment
Publisher: Soldak Entertainment
Release Date: Aug 24, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 25, 2024




About This Game

Din’s Champion is a sidescrolling 2D action RPG in a highly dynamic fantasy setting. The world waits for no one; as you are exploring and collecting, crafting and building, planning, the forces of darkness are amassing power and executing their own designs. Left unchecked, they will unleash devastating consequences! Will you find strength in numbers, building a massive town with an army of dozens or even hundreds of NPCs, gathering enough resources and resilience to survive whatever crisis is thrown your way? Or will you strike out alone against the evil, relying on your own skills and strength to prevail?

FEATURES

  • Truly vast character customization system, with dozens of classes, each with their own skill-trees, strengths and weaknesses. Craft and equip the best gear with different stats and perks for your perfect warrior!

  • Multiplayer mode lets your friends join in the fun; survive, thrive, and push back the forces of the evil gods together!

  • Mighty and varied enemy forces, always scheming and striking and escalating. Monsters can plan ambushes and even instigate uprisings! If you do not work to stem the tide, you will be overwhelmed.

  • Every choice has consequences. Who will you stop to save? Will you focus on curing the deadly plague or will you gather resources instead? Every moment has a hundred different possibilities!

PLAY WITH A MIND TOWARDS MINING

Stone and clay; trees; walls and mountains and the ground beneath your feet; if you can see it, you can take it! Gather resources wherever you go, both in the foreground and the background, allowing you to craft all sorts of powerful items, potions, buildings, and more! But be judicious: all the time you spend gathering stones is time the enemy spends gathering strength!

A WORLD AT WAR

A massive variety of enemies– hundreds of different monster-types to be found in different biomes, with different abilities and behaviors, coordinated by powerful bosses with a will of their own! Monsters do more than just wait around for you to come kill them, and they don’t simply seek you out, either. The forces of darkness will concoct different strategies as you play, trying to lure you into deadly ambushes, pilfer your resources, spread plagues and curses throughout your town, or keep you busy long enough to build up power and unleash a devastating cataclysm!

item.title: Eslabong
item.description:
Title: Eslabong
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: shirowita
Publisher: shirowita
Release Date: Aug 24, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 24, 2026




About This Game

Control one fighter in fast-paced arena battles. Aim abilities, move, and react in real time to outplay your opponents through positioning and timing. Or step back, set tactics, and watch your team fight.

Win fights to earn gold, buy and sell mercenaries, and strengthen your roster. Discover classes with unique abilities, shape your team, and upgrade it across seasons.

Put your team to the test in structured leagues and tournaments. Face powerful clubs and unique leaders, recruit rare champions, and climb your way to the top.

Every run forces new decisions. Randomized stats, evolving rosters, and dynamic opponents keep each season different, while the market gives you new ways to adapt and improve.

A medieval world where war has been replaced by arena combat. Clubs of mercenaries compete in structured leagues for power, gold, and prestige. Enter the arena. Climb to the top.

item.title: Iron Blight
item.description:
Title: Iron Blight
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Ronesans Interactive
Publisher: Rock Paper Publisher
Franchise: Rock Paper Publisher
Release Date: Aug 24, 2026




About This Game

The world is dead. The state has collapsed. In a forgotten Eastern Bloc town, you are alone but not truly alone. Something stirs beyond the walls, and none of it means you well. You have only one reason to keep going: survive long enough to find your wife, Valeria. But in the cold and darkness of this unforgiving night, will you ever make it back to her?

In the hellish streets of this Eastern Bloc town, every bullet matters. There are ways to fight back, but survival demands more than firepower. Use the weapons at your disposal to clear a path, scavenge tools to overcome the obstacles ahead, and avoid unnecessary confrontations whenever you can.

Iron Blight aims to deliver an immersive gameplay experience built around atmosphere, vulnerability, and the crushing weight of isolation. Every bullet matters, and the sound of gunfire may draw even more horrors to your position. Even something as simple as opening a locked door demands thought. You must manage your food and medical supplies, move cautiously through the streets, and always consider what might be waiting around the next corner.

  • True Survival Horror Gameplay: Navigate desolate streets and claustrophobic interiors, where danger lurks around every corner. Solve puzzles and face the terrors that will force a choice: fight, flee, or die.

  • Resource Scarcity and Tension: Resources are scarce. Do you risk using your last bullet to take down a monster, or do you save it for a more critical moment and hope to slip past unnoticed?

  • Diegetic Grid-Based Inventory: Every single item matters, and space is a luxury you can't afford. Carefully manage your limited inventory grid, making agonizing choices about what to carry and what to leave behind.

  • No HUD, No Distractions: No health bars, no ammo counters, no intrusive menus. Every piece of information is conveyed through your character and the world around you. Your only interface is your own perception.

  • A Unique Weapon System: Check your magazines manually, round by precious round, and reload with deliberate, step-by-step actions. Every firefight becomes a tense test of your nerves and skill.

  • A Bleak and Oppressive Atmosphere: Rain-slick cobblestones and flickering fluorescent lights lead you deeper into a town that feels cold, hostile, and suffocating. The distant cries of things that should not exist echo through its desolate streets.

  • A Return to Forgotten Horror Traditions: Fear comes from the atmosphere, the gnawing uncertainty, and the constant presence of death. The story is told through the environment itself, and combat is a slow, methodical dance where every shot matters.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game contains violence, blood, gore, graphic injuries, and depictions of death. It also includes alcohol and tobacco use. There is no sexual content or drug abuse.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or Equivalent
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti 2 GB or Equivalent
    • Storage: 1 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 or Equivalent
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB
    • Storage: 1 GB available space
